fields.text_en: Only a clicking sound when turning the key
fields.text_roman: Chaabi ghumane par sirf click ki awaaz aati hai

fields.text_en: Dashboard lights dim or go out when turning the key
fields.text_roman: Chaabi ghumane par dashboard ki lights dheemi ya band ho jati hain

fields.text_en: Nothing happens at all when turning the key
fields.text_roman: Chaabi ghumane par bilkul kuch nahi hota

fields.text_en: Fuel pump is silent when the ignition is switched on
fields.text_roman: Ignition on karne par fuel pump ki halki awaaz nahi aati

fields.text_en: Security or key light keeps flashing on the dashboard
fields.text_roman: Dashboard par security ya chaabi ki light jhapakti rehti hai

fields.name: Weak or dead battery
fields.description: The battery cannot supply enough current to crank the engine.
fields.proof_hint: Ask the mechanic to show the test or measurement that confirms: weak or dead battery.

fields.steps: Try the headlights: if they are dim or die when you turn the key, the battery is weak. A jump-start that works confirms it.

fields.source: PLACEHOLDER - replace with a verified quote

fields.name: Loose or corroded battery terminals
fields.description: Poor contact at the terminals blocks current even with a good battery.
fields.proof_hint: Ask the mechanic to show the test or measurement that confirms: loose or corroded battery terminals.

fields.steps: With the car off, check that both terminals are tight and free of white or green crust.

fields.source: PLACEHOLDER - replace with a verified quote

fields.name: Faulty starter motor or solenoid
fields.description: The starter does not turn the engine even though the battery is good.
fields.proof_hint: Ask the mechanic to show the test or measurement that confirms: faulty starter motor or solenoid.

fields.steps: If lights stay bright but you only hear one loud click, the starter is the likely cause.

fields.source: PLACEHOLDER - replace with a verified quote

fields.name: Failed fuel pump or fuel pump relay
fields.description: The engine cranks but no fuel reaches it.
fields.proof_hint: Ask the mechanic to show the test or measurement that confirms: failed fuel pump or fuel pump relay.

fields.steps: Switch the ignition on and listen near the rear seat for a 2 second hum. Silence points to the pump, relay or fuse.

fields.source: PLACEHOLDER - replace with a verified quote

fields.name: Immobiliser or key fault
fields.description: The car does not recognise the key and blocks starting.
fields.proof_hint: Ask the mechanic to show the test or measurement that confirms: immobiliser or key fault.

fields.steps: Try the spare key and check whether the security light flashes.

fields.source: PLACEHOLDER - replace with a verified quote

fields.text_en: When you turn the key, what happens?
fields.text_roman: Chaabi ghumane par kya hota hai?

fields.label: Only a click or dim lights
The engine cranks but will not start
fields.label_roman: Engine ghoomta hai lekin start nahi hota

fields.text_en: Do the dashboard lights dim or go out when you turn the key?
fields.text_roman: Kya chaabi ghumane par dashboard ki lights dheemi ya band ho jati hain?

fields.text_en: Do you hear only a clicking sound when you turn the key?
fields.text_roman: Kya chaabi ghumane par sirf click ki awaaz aati hai?

fields.text_en: Does nothing at all happen when you turn the key?
fields.text_roman: Kya chaabi ghumane par bilkul kuch nahi hota?

fields.text_en: Does the engine turn over (crank) but never catch and run?
fields.text_roman: Kya engine ghoomta hai lekin kabhi chalu nahi hota?

fields.text_en: With the ignition on, is the fuel pump silent (no short hum for about 2 seconds)?
fields.text_roman: Ignition on karne par kya fuel pump ki halki awaaz nahi aati?

fields.text_en: Is a security or key light flashing on the dashboard?
fields.text_roman: Kya dashboard par security ya chaabi ki light jhapak rahi hai?

fields.text_en: Does the engine crank for much longer than usual before it starts?
fields.text_roman: Kya engine start hone se pehle normal se zyada der ghoomta hai?

fields.text_en: Has the battery been weak lately, especially on cold mornings?
fields.text_roman: Kya battery haal hi mein kamzor rahi hai, khaas tor par thandi subah mein?

fields.text_en: Temperature gauge climbs above the middle
fields.text_roman: Temperature gauge beech se upar chala jata hai

fields.text_en: Steam or smoke coming from under the bonnet
fields.text_roman: Bonnet ke neeche se bhaap ya dhuan nikalta hai

fields.text_en: Heater blows cold air while the engine is hot
fields.text_roman: Engine garam hone par bhi heater thandi hawa deta hai

fields.name: Low coolant or a coolant leak
fields.description: Not enough coolant is left to carry heat away from the engine.
fields.proof_hint: Ask the mechanic to show the test or measurement that confirms: low coolant or a coolant leak.

fields.steps: When the engine is completely cold, check the coolant tank level and look under the car for drips.

fields.source: PLACEHOLDER - replace with a verified quote

fields.name: Stuck thermostat
fields.description: The thermostat stays closed and traps hot coolant in the engine.
fields.proof_hint: Ask the mechanic to show the test or measurement that confirms: stuck thermostat.

fields.steps: With the engine hot, the upper radiator hose is hot but the lower hose stays cold.

fields.source: PLACEHOLDER - replace with a verified quote

fields.name: Radiator fan or fan relay failure
fields.description: The fan does not blow air through the radiator when the car is stopped.
fields.proof_hint: Ask the mechanic to show the test or measurement that confirms: radiator fan or fan relay failure.

fields.steps: Let the engine warm up at idle: the fan should start within a few minutes. If it never does, check the fuse and relay.

fields.source: PLACEHOLDER - replace with a verified quote

fields.name: Failing water pump
fields.description: The pump does not circulate coolant properly.
fields.proof_hint: Ask the mechanic to show the test or measurement that confirms: failing water pump.

fields.steps: Look for coolant leaking from the pump or a whining noise at the front of the engine.

fields.source: PLACEHOLDER - replace with a verified quote

fields.name: Head gasket leak
fields.description: Combustion gases or coolant leak between the engine block and head.
fields.proof_hint: Ask the mechanic to show the test or measurement that confirms: head gasket leak.

fields.steps: Look for white exhaust smoke, milky oil on the dipstick or constantly bubbling coolant.

fields.source: PLACEHOLDER - replace with a verified quote

fields.text_en: When does the temperature rise?
fields.text_roman: Temperature kab barhta hai?

fields.label: Mostly when stopped or in traffic
fields.label_roman: Zyada tar ruke hue ya traffic mein

fields.text_en: When the engine is hot, does the cooling fan stay off?
fields.text_roman: Engine garam hone par kya cooling fan band rehta hai?

fields.text_en: Is the coolant tank low, or do you see coolant under the car or smell something sweet?
fields.text_roman: Kya coolant ka tank kam hai, ya gaari ke neeche coolant ya meethi boo hai?

fields.text_en: Do you see steam or smoke coming from under the bonnet?
fields.text_roman: Kya bonnet ke neeche se bhaap ya dhuan nikal raha hai?

fields.text_en: Does the heater blow cold air while the engine is hot?
fields.text_roman: Kya engine garam hone par bhi heater thandi hawa deta hai?

fields.text_en: Does the temperature gauge climb above the middle mark?
fields.text_roman: Kya temperature gauge beech ke nishan se upar jata hai?

fields.text_en: Does the temperature mainly rise when the car is stopped or idling in traffic?
fields.text_roman: Kya temperature zyada tar ruke hue ya traffic mein barhta hai?

fields.text_en: Steering wheel or brake pedal shakes when braking
fields.text_roman: Brake lagane par steering ya brake pedal hilta hai

fields.text_en: Squealing or screeching noise when braking
fields.text_roman: Brake lagane par cheekhne ki awaaz aati hai

fields.text_en: Grinding noise when braking
fields.text_roman: Brake lagane par ragadne ki awaaz aati hai

fields.text_en: Brake pedal feels soft or sinks toward the floor
fields.text_roman: Brake pedal naram lagta hai ya neeche tak chala jata hai

fields.text_en: Car pulls to one side when braking
fields.text_roman: Brake lagane par gaari aik taraf kheenchti hai

fields.name: Warped brake discs
fields.description: Uneven discs make the pedal and steering shake under braking.
fields.proof_hint: Ask the mechanic to show the test or measurement that confirms: warped brake discs.

fields.steps: Brake gently from about 80 km/h on a clear road: shaking that grows with speed points to the discs.

fields.source: PLACEHOLDER - replace with a verified quote

fields.name: Worn brake pads
fields.description: Thin pads squeal, then grind against the disc.
fields.proof_hint: Ask the mechanic to show the test or measurement that confirms: worn brake pads.

fields.steps: Look through the wheel spokes at the pad thickness. Under about 3 mm means replace.

fields.source: PLACEHOLDER - replace with a verified quote

fields.name: Seized brake caliper
fields.description: A stuck caliper drags on one wheel and pulls the car sideways.
fields.proof_hint: Ask the mechanic to show the test or measurement that confirms: seized brake caliper.

fields.steps: After a drive, one wheel hub being much hotter than the others suggests a seized caliper.

fields.source: PLACEHOLDER - replace with a verified quote

fields.name: Brake fluid leak or air in the brake lines
fields.description: Lost pressure in the brake system makes the pedal soft.
fields.proof_hint: Ask the mechanic to show the test or measurement that confirms: brake fluid leak or air in the brake lines.

fields.steps: Check the brake fluid level and look for wet patches behind the wheels. Do not drive if the pedal sinks.

fields.source: PLACEHOLDER - replace with a verified quote

fields.text_en: What do you notice when you brake?
fields.text_roman: Brake lagane par aap ko kya mehsoos hota hai?

fields.label: Shaking in the pedal or steering
The pedal feels soft or sinks
fields.label_roman: Pedal naram lagta hai ya neeche jata hai

fields.text_en: Does the steering wheel or brake pedal shake when you brake from speed?
fields.text_roman: Kya raftaar se brake lagane par steering ya pedal hilta hai?

fields.text_en: Do you hear a squealing or screeching noise when you brake?
fields.text_roman: Kya brake lagane par cheekhne ki awaaz aati hai?

fields.text_en: Do you hear a metal grinding noise when you brake?
fields.text_roman: Kya brake lagane par dhaat ke ragadne ki awaaz aati hai?

fields.text_en: Does the car pull to one side when you brake?
fields.text_roman: Kya brake lagane par gaari aik taraf kheenchti hai?

fields.text_en: Does the brake pedal feel soft or sink toward the floor?
fields.text_roman: Kya brake pedal naram lagta hai ya neeche tak chala jata hai?

fields.text_en: No click from the engine bay when the AC is switched on
fields.text_roman: AC on karne par engine bay se click ki awaaz nahi aati

fields.text_en: Weak airflow from the vents even at full fan speed
fields.text_roman: Poori fan speed par bhi vents se hawa kamzor aati hai

fields.text_en: AC is cold while driving but warm when stopped
fields.text_roman: AC chalte hue thanda hai lekin ruke hue garam

fields.text_en: Hissing sound or oily residue near the AC pipes
fields.text_roman: AC ke pipes ke qareeb hissing ya tel jaisa nishan

fields.name: Low refrigerant or a leak in the AC system
fields.description: Not enough gas is left to cool the air.
fields.proof_hint: Ask the mechanic to show the test or measurement that confirms: low refrigerant or a leak in the ac system.

fields.steps: Look for oily patches on AC pipe joints. A gas refill that fades in weeks means there is a leak.

fields.source: PLACEHOLDER - replace with a verified quote

fields.name: Compressor or compressor clutch failure
fields.description: The compressor does not pump gas around the system.
fields.proof_hint: Ask the mechanic to show the test or measurement that confirms: compressor or compressor clutch failure.

fields.steps: With the AC on, the centre of the compressor pulley should spin. If it does not, the clutch is not engaging.

fields.source: PLACEHOLDER - replace with a verified quote

fields.name: Condenser fan not working
fields.description: Without airflow over the condenser the AC fades at idle.
fields.proof_hint: Ask the mechanic to show the test or measurement that confirms: condenser fan not working.

fields.steps: At idle with the AC on, the front fan should run. If it is still, check its fuse and relay.

fields.source: PLACEHOLDER - replace with a verified quote

fields.name: Blocked cabin filter or weak blower
fields.description: Airflow is restricted so cooling feels weak.
fields.proof_hint: Ask the mechanic to show the test or measurement that confirms: blocked cabin filter or weak blower.

fields.steps: Inspect the cabin filter behind the glovebox. A dirty filter is cheap to replace.

fields.source: PLACEHOLDER - replace with a verified quote

fields.name: Blown AC fuse or relay
fields.description: The compressor clutch gets no power.
fields.proof_hint: Ask the mechanic to show the test or measurement that confirms: blown ac fuse or relay.

fields.steps: Check the AC fuse and relay in the fuse box using the manual.

fields.source: PLACEHOLDER - replace with a verified quote

fields.text_en: How is the air from the vents?
fields.text_roman: Vents se hawa kaisi aati hai?

fields.label: Cold only while driving, warm when stopped
fields.label_roman: Chalte hue thandi, ruke hue garam

fields.label: Cool but the airflow is weak

fields.text_en: With the engine running and the AC on, can you not hear a click as the compressor engages?
fields.text_roman: Engine chalu aur AC on karne par kya compressor lagne ki click nahi aati?

fields.text_en: Do you hear hissing or see oily residue near the AC pipes?
fields.text_roman: Kya AC ke pipes ke qareeb hissing ya tel jaisa nishan hai?

fields.text_en: Is the AC cold while driving but warm when you stop?
fields.text_roman: Kya AC chalte hue thanda lekin ruke hue garam hota hai?

fields.text_en: Is the airflow weak even with the fan at full speed?
fields.text_roman: Kya poori fan speed par bhi hawa kamzor hai?

fields.text_en: Car needs a jump-start after sitting for a day or two
fields.text_roman: Aik do din khari rehne ke baad gaari ko dhakka ya jump start chahiye

fields.text_en: Battery is more than three to four years old
fields.text_roman: Battery teen se chaar saal se purani hai

fields.text_en: Headlights dim at idle or the battery light comes on while driving
fields.text_roman: Idle par headlights dheemi ya chalte hue battery light jal jati hai

fields.text_en: Something stays on after the car is locked
fields.text_roman: Gaari lock karne ke baad bhi koi cheez on rehti hai

fields.text_en: Battery terminals are loose or covered in crust
fields.text_roman: Battery ke terminals dheelay ya zang se dhake hue hain

fields.name: Old or worn-out battery
fields.description: The battery can no longer hold a full charge.
fields.proof_hint: Ask the mechanic to show the test or measurement that confirms: old or worn-out battery.

fields.steps: Have the battery load-tested at a shop (often free). Age over 3 to 4 years makes this likely.

fields.source: PLACEHOLDER - replace with a verified quote

fields.name: Faulty alternator
fields.description: The battery is not recharged while driving.
fields.proof_hint: Ask the mechanic to show the test or measurement that confirms: faulty alternator.

fields.steps: With the engine running, a healthy alternator shows about 13.8 to 14.4 V across the battery.

fields.source: PLACEHOLDER - replace with a verified quote

fields.name: Parasitic drain from a device left on
fields.description: Something keeps drawing current after the car is off.
fields.proof_hint: Ask the mechanic to show the test or measurement that confirms: parasitic drain from a device left on.

fields.steps: Check boot, glovebox and interior lights, and unplug dashcams or chargers overnight.

fields.source: PLACEHOLDER - replace with a verified quote

fields.name: Loose or corroded battery terminals
fields.description: Poor contact stops proper charging and starting.
fields.proof_hint: Ask the mechanic to show the test or measurement that confirms: loose or corroded battery terminals.

fields.steps: Check both terminals are tight and clean.

fields.source: PLACEHOLDER - replace with a verified quote

fields.text_en: How does the battery problem show up?
fields.text_roman: Battery ka masla kaise samne aata hai?

fields.label: Dead after sitting overnight or a day
fields.label_roman: Raat ya din bhar khari rehne ke baad dead

fields.label: Dies or lights dim while driving
fields.label_roman: Chalte hue band ya lights dheemi

fields.label: Slow cranking, needs a jump-start
fields.label_roman: Start dheemay hota hai, jump start chahiye

fields.text_en: Does the car need a jump-start after sitting for a day or two?
fields.text_roman: Kya aik do din khari rehne ke baad gaari ko jump start chahiye?

fields.text_en: Is the battery more than three to four years old?
fields.text_roman: Kya battery teen se chaar saal se purani hai?

fields.text_en: Do the headlights dim at idle, or does the battery light come on while driving?
fields.text_roman: Kya idle par headlights dheemi hoti hain ya chalte hue battery light jalti hai?

fields.text_en: Could something be left on after you lock the car (interior light, dashcam, stereo)?
fields.text_roman: Kya gaari lock karne ke baad koi cheez on reh sakti hai (light, dashcam, stereo)?

fields.text_en: Do the battery terminals look loose or covered in white or green crust?
fields.text_roman: Kya battery ke terminals dheelay ya safaid/hare zang se dhake hain?
